dedupe_keys.name: ubgg 3m 3 m urban blue green gray landscape maps for 36 chinese cities

description: UBGG-3m maps the urban blue-green-gray landscape, water, vegetation and built surfaces, at 3 m resolution for 36 Chinese metropolises. Zhiyu Xu of Peking University and Shuqing Zhao of Hainan University produced it with a transferable multi-scale high-resolution convolutional neural network applied to 336 Planet images, and published it with a data descriptor in Scientific Data in March 2024. A companion sample set, UBGGset, holds 14,627 labelled images covering 2,272 km2 of urban landscape at 3 m. Validation in five cities across regions gives an overall accuracy of 91.2% and a frequency-weighted IoU of 83.9%, and comparisons show more detail than existing land cover products. Coverage is 36 major Chinese cities. Format and access: maps and samples on Zenodo. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: it is a single-period map, and classes follow the authors' scheme. Fine maps of blue and green space support urban heat, flood and green-blue infrastructure studies. Related catalogue records are the China 1 km land use projections and the Copernicus Urban Atlas, a European counterpart.
